acquisition_requests_marketing_consent_c.name: acquisition_requests_marketing_consent_check
acquisition_requests_marketing_consent_c.value: ("app"."acquisition_requests"."marketing_consent" and "app"."acquisition_requests"."marketing_consented_at" is not null) or (not "app"."acquisition_requests"."marketing_consent" and "app"."acquisition_requests"."marketing_consented_at" is null)

delivery_attempts_provider_message_check.name: delivery_attempts_provider_message_check
delivery_attempts_provider_message_check.value: ("app"."delivery_attempts"."status" = 'accepted' and "app"."delivery_attempts"."provider_message_id" is not null and length(btrim("app"."delivery_attempts"."provider_message_id")) > 0) or ("app"."delivery_attempts"."status" <> 'accepted' and "app"."delivery_attempts"."provider_message_id" is null)

product_version_assets_customer_filename.name: product_version_assets_customer_filename_check
product_version_assets_customer_filename.value: length(btrim("app"."product_version_assets"."customer_filename")) > 0 and "app"."product_version_assets"."customer_filename" not in ('.', '..') and position('/' in "app"."product_version_assets"."customer_filename") = 0 and position(chr(92) in "app"."product_version_assets"."customer_filename") = 0
